summary: In a danger the writer moves what they own to a friend's house and sleeps near their work.
realLife: In the Great Fire, Pepys moved his money and plate to a friend's house and slept in the office.
sources: Diary of Samuel Pepys, September 1666 (the Great Fire), Wikisource: https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Diary_of_Samuel_Pepys/1666/September
inGame: needs: a household emergency record (fire, flood) that moves what the person owns.
